014 docs/IMPLEMENTATION_RECIPES.md

# Implementation recipes

## Fixed transition dispatch

Define STEP_HANDLERS as a static mapping from WorkflowStep to an injected async function. A handler receives typed current state and returns StepOutcome. next_step uses explicit conditions from WORKFLOW.md and rejects a transition not in the allowed table. There is no prompt that asks a model which function to call. During early foundation work, inject deterministic test handlers; wire production handlers when their owning foundations exist. Avoid importing future modules merely to satisfy a type annotation.

The runner calculates the input hash before work, checks workflow_step_results for a matching completed value, and performs external calls outside a row lock. On completion, it uses a transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE on the enquiry and verifies job lease token, current revision and demo generation. Only then can it insert step results and advance state. A failed check returns obsolete and discards output. Tests pause a fake provider call, change the revision, and then release the call to prove stale results cannot commit.

## Idempotency transaction

Hash canonical request JSON together with authenticated actor, HTTP method and normalized route path. Insert an idempotency record under its unique scope/key. If the existing hash differs, return409. If the operation is completed, replay its stored status/body. If it is still in progress, return a stable conflict/retry response rather than running it again. The business write, job creation, audit and saved response occur in one transaction. A process crash before commit leaves no partial accepted request. External provider calls occur later in jobs, not inside this transaction.

## Catalogue hash and identity

Sort records by(entity_type, entity_key). Serialize each payload as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, decimal strings and normalized timestamp format. Exclude generated search_document and volatile import timestamps. Hash the complete canonical record stream with SHA256. Validate unique keys before constructing a lookup dictionary. Reusing VERSION_ID with different content is an integrity error. Preserve leading zeros in serial text while separately validating numeric ranges. Numeric IDs for new entities are allocated before sealing the source version and retained on every retry.

## Compatibility and ranking

Resolve exactly one model configuration. Load only the active version's explicit part_compatibility rows for that configuration. Reject missing source references. Pass that allowed ID set into lexical and semantic candidate retrieval so an incompatible perfect textual match never reaches scoring. Combine scores using the characterized legacy formula and deterministic tie order. Calculate the best-versus-runner-up margin before truncating results. A request for limit1 does not remove evidence of ambiguity. Use code-owned thresholds and labelled evaluation cases; do not call a score a calibrated probability.

## Quantity allocation

Build total demand per part across all enquiry items. For each part, read the same stock snapshot, calculate available=max(0, on_hand-reserved) only after validating the source values, and allocate local stock first. Sort reachable warehouses deterministically by approved transfer duration and stable warehouse ID. Never invent a missing route. Subtract each allocation from one shared in-memory availability ledger before allocating another item. Report shortage explicitly. A planner does not mutate stock or create a reservation. Approval reruns the checks against the current snapshot and freshness policy.

## Fact-bound reply

The LLM returns only ReplySlots. Code renders part numbers, quantities, warehouses, estimates and references from VerifiedFacts. Reject or replace model slots containing unsupported identifiers or quantitative claims. Serialize and hash the verified facts independently of prose. Store the draft with revision, catalogue version and fact hash. An edit cannot directly set approval. Approval locks and revalidates the current state before inserting decision, recommendation and audit together. A known database number that is incompatible still fails verification.

## Redacted reporting outbox

Write a small analytical event in the same business transaction. Export only EVENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, OCCURRED_AT, IS_DEMO, STATUS, STAGE, DURATION_MS, INPUT_TOKENS, OUTPUT_TOKENS and ESTIMATED_COST_USD. Reject any extra field before building SQL. MERGE by EVENT_ID under a single exporter lease using bound parameters. Compare identical existing data on replay; conflicting data is an integrity error. Save Snowflake query ID and acknowledge locally only after success. Never export raw customer text, serials, notes, photos, keys or signed URLs.

## REST adapter example

A feature router declares response_model and explicit success status. Its verified actor dependency executes before the facade. The facade receives path IDs, typed command and idempotency key; it rejects mismatching enquiry IDs in the body. It invokes one domain function and maps named domain failures through the shared Problem handler. A browser sends only candidate ID or corrected fields, never an authoritative fitment fact. UI state is refreshed after writes. On409, it preserves unsent input and requires a fresh action against the new revision.

## Test fixtures and replay

Use a fake clock, isolated database transaction, test actor factory and deterministic provider adapter. Keep at least two customers, two demo sessions, assigned/unassigned reviewers and an admin in permission fixtures. The four demonstration fixtures are not the entire evaluation dataset. Add independent Arabic variants, serial endpoints, wrong part numbers and duplicate-part allocation cases. Store expected compatible IDs and clarification outcomes from reviewed catalogue facts. Never change expected outputs simply because the implementation produced a different answer.

015 docs/SECURITY.md

# Security and permission design

## Trust boundaries

Browser requests are untrusted. Supabase tokens are verified for issuer, audience, signature, algorithm and expiry. Role membership is loaded server-side. Customer text, OCR text, imported documents and model replies are data, not instructions to privileged code. The AI API has no tools for writes or approval. Snowflake queries use bound values and fixed identifiers.

## Access matrix

| Resource | Customer or own demo | Assigned reviewer | Catalogue admin | Admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Own enquiry/messages/progress | Read and allowed input changes | Assigned real enquiry | No automatic access | Operational access |
| Candidates and full evidence | Own demo reviewer only | Assigned enquiry | No automatic access | Operational access |
| Approve/edit/reject | Own demo reviewer only | Assigned enquiry | No automatic access | Operational access |
| Internal notes/audit | Own demo reviewer only | Assigned enquiry | No automatic access | Operational access |
| Published catalogue | Read active data | Read | Stage/validate/publish | Stage/validate/publish |
| Assignments | No | No | No | Manage |
| AI allowance/evaluation curation | No | No | No | Manage |
| Snowflake aggregate reports | No | No | No | Read |

An invited user can hold multiple roles explicitly. A catalogue admin is not implicitly a reviewer. API access labels are defined in REST_API.md. PostgreSQL runtime groups are technical permissions and must not be mistaken for human application roles.

## Database and file controls

Use RLS on every application table. anon/authenticated cannot access application tables directly except explicitly defined Storage policies. API uses a least-privilege LOGIN role with only the partsiq_api group; worker code selects purpose-specific pools with workflow/search/worker/catalogue groups. Do not use an owner/service-role database connection for ordinary business queries. Trusted jobs authorize by their persisted enquiry/revision and do not accept arbitrary user-selected table IDs.

Storage buckets are private. Use server-chosen object keys and short-lived signed URLs. Check actual image bytes and decoded size, strip metadata, and reject path traversal. Evidence/export download checks assignment or ownership at issuance; already issued URLs have a bounded validity window. PDF rendering blocks external network requests.

## Abuse and reliability

Apply per-identity/IP request limits, upload size limits and bounded pagination. Redis limiter failure denies new rate-limited work instead of removing protection. Idempotency keys bind actor, method, path and payload hash. Worker leases prevent expired results overwriting new revisions. API CORS allows only explicit frontend origins. CSP and output escaping limit injected markup. Never display unescaped AI/customer text as HTML.

Audit rows are immutable to runtime roles; schema owners retain administrative capabilities, so describe this honestly. Store minimal before/after fields and redact secrets. Role changes, assignment, approval, publication, imports and allowance changes are auditable. Real retention requires a client decision before onboarding; demo access expires after24hours, with cleanup and minimal audit retention documented separately.

016 docs/CONSTRAINTS.md

# Nonnegotiable constraints

- All 69 feature groups remain; voice and quotation builder stay excluded.
- One application package and fixed Python workflow. No LangGraph, supervisor, specialist-agent team or LLM-selected next steps.
- LLMs extract and draft only. Compatibility, stock allocation, verification and approval are code-controlled.
- Snowflake source versions are immutable and explicitly validated. PostgreSQL owns the active serving pointer and transactional application integrity.
- No incompatible candidate can enter the ranked set. Supersession does not imply fitment inheritance.
- Missing serials, unconfirmed OCR and close scores trigger clarification/review.
- Every final recommendation requires current human approval and audit; clarifying questions do not require approval.
- Real review is assignment scoped; demo review is own-session scoped. Demo generation/expiry are checked at final job commit.
- Private files stay private; customers receive compatibility references, staff receive authorized evidence viewer access.
- BGE-M3 runs only in the worker search module; lexical mode remains usable when semantic capability is disabled.
- No paid fallback. Live OpenAI, Snowflake and hosting require confirmed account-specific allowance. Zero budget is not a promise of free services forever.
- No order/reservation/payment/external message is created. Warehouse planning is an estimate from a timestamped snapshot.
- No production reset or automatic dependency upgrade. Migration-owner credentials never run the application.
- Audit is append-only for runtime roles, not mathematically tamper-proof against database owners.
- No raw prompts, photos, keys, JWTs or signed URLs in telemetry. Analytics exports only allowlisted fields.
- Claims about performance, accuracy, availability, client adoption and hosted status require actual receipts.

017 docs/DECISIONS.md

# Architecture decisions

## ADR001 Extend the legacy backend

Accepted. Preserve the supplied backend archive and characterize its identification, lexical ranking and fulfilment behavior. Consolidate those modules under partsiq.search in the new package through explicit import/path adaptation. Do not rewrite working algorithms just to change framework shape. Original source remains available for comparison.

## ADR002 Hosting and cost

Amended. Next.js remains on Vercel and Supabase remains managed. One EC2 instance runs Caddy, API, worker and Redis using Docker Compose only when confirmed AWS allowance covers the deployment. Render is a documented alternative, not the chosen deployment. No long-term free-hosting claim. A local fixture deployment remains supported.

## ADR003 Replace multi-agent orchestration

Accepted16 October 2026. User requested the complete pre-multi-agent feature set with a simpler runtime. Remove LangGraph, checkpoint-library tables, supervisor routing, specialist agents and internal search/orchestrator HTTP services. Use ordinary Python functions, fixed transitions, PostgreSQL step results and durable leased jobs. This changes implementation architecture, not feature scope.

## ADR004 Snowflake source with validated relational serving

Accepted for this revision. Snowflake holds versioned source catalogue/inventory and reporting data. Supabase PostgreSQL stores application records and a validated serving mirror. Standard Snowflake PK/FK declarations do not enforce uniqueness/referential integrity; publication validation and PostgreSQL constraints are retained. Activation is atomic locally; cross-system upload is recoverable and not falsely described as a distributed transaction.

## ADR005 Single active source mode

Accepted. DATA_SOURCE is fixture or snowflake and must be explicit. A live provider error never silently changes source. Both modes use identical validators. UI and receipts display provenance and freshness. Fixture results cannot count as live provider evidence.

## ADR006 Scope and roles

Accepted. All 69 groups retained with one detailed feature implementation prompt each. No voice or quotation builder. Public demo uses anonymous Supabase users and session isolation; real users are invited and real onboarding stays disabled until retention is configured. Reviewers access assigned enquiries; admins manage assignment.

## ADR007 No paid fallback

Accepted. User supplied free keys and a zero-paid-spend budget. The application reserves only confirmed available allowance with expiry and does not infer credit balance from key validity. Snowflake trial and cloud account eligibility are operator preflight items. No new paid provider is selected automatically.

## Commands

Foundation 00: uv venv --python 3.12, then uv pip sync spec/python-requirements.lock. Copy the selected runtime dependencies into pyproject.toml and generate the project lock without changing pins. The supplied reference lock includes test/tool dependencies for reproducibility; production image may use a derived runtime subset with the same versions. Pin the exact CPU torch wheel URL/hash from the lock; do not install CUDA packages on the CPU host.

Foundation 18: copy spec/web-package.json to apps/web/package.json and spec/pnpm-lock.yaml to apps/web/pnpm-lock.yaml; run corepack pnpm --dir apps/web install --frozen-lockfile. Node 22.22.0 is the target. The earlier frontend resolver ran on Node 24; the target build still needs execution. Use packageManager pnpm10.30.3. PythonPlaywright1.58.0 and webPlaywright1.58.2 are separate installations; install each browser binary with its own CLI and never share an unversioned browser cache between them.

Foundation 02 uses snowflake-connector-python4.8.0 already included in the reference lock. No Snowpark, Pandas, agent framework or Cortex SDK is needed. Langfuse is optional and never on the business-critical path. Do not restore LangGraph through a transitive convenience dependency.

## Upgrade policy

Before a dependency change, record the reason, official release date, target-runtime compatibility and security impact. Resolve the complete lock, run focused regression tests and document the new receipts. A package existing on a registry is not proof that the application is compatible or secure. Do not claim all transitives meet the14-day release criterion unless each has been independently verified; the explicit criterion applies to the direct pins in the receipt table.

020 docs/ENVIRONMENT.md

# Environment contract

Empty secret/account values are intentionally required operator inputs, not fabricated credentials. Local fixture mode needs local Supabase values but no Snowflake/OpenAI key. Copy environment.example to ignored .env during implementation.

| Variable | Default | Consumer | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| APP_ENV | local | API and worker | local, dev or prod; tests reject prod |
| DATA_SOURCE | fixture | Worker | fixture or snowflake; never automatic fallback |
| AI_MODE | fixture | Worker | fixture or live; fixture banner mandatory |
| REAL_ONBOARDING_ENABLED | false | API | Remain false until client retention is agreed |
| DATABASE_URL_API | Required when applicable | API | Least-privilege LOGIN with partsiq_api |
| DATABASE_URL_WORKFLOW | Required when applicable | Worker | LOGIN with partsiq_workflow |
| DATABASE_URL_SEARCH | Required when applicable | Worker | LOGIN with partsiq_search |
| DATABASE_URL_WORKER | Required when applicable | Worker | LOGIN with partsiq_worker |
| DATABASE_URL_CATALOGUE | Required when applicable | Worker | LOGIN with partsiq_catalogue |
| DATABASE_URL_MIGRATION | Required when applicable | Migration command only | Schema owner; never runtime |
| SUPABASE_URL | Required when applicable | API and web | Development or production project URL |
| SUPABASE_ANON_KEY | Required when applicable | Web | Public browser key; authorization still required |
| SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY | Required when applicable | Storage adapter only | Secret; never used for ordinary database queries |
| SUPABASE_JWT_ISSUER | Required when applicable | API | Exact configured auth issuer |
| SUPABASE_JWT_AUDIENCE | authenticated | API | Exact JWT audience |
| REDIS_URL | redis://redis:6379/0 | API and worker | Private Compose network |
| ALLOWED_ORIGINS | http://localhost:3000 | API | Comma-separated exact origins |
| OPENAI_API_KEY | Required when applicable | Worker | Secret live key |
| OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL | Required when applicable | Worker | Owner-approved available structured-output model |
| OPENAI_VISION_MODEL | Required when applicable | Worker | Owner-approved available image model |
| AI_ALLOWANCE_EXPIRES_AT | Required when applicable | Preflight | Owner-confirmed expiry in UTC; no invented value |
| AI_CONFIRMED_ALLOWANCE_USD | 0 | Preflight | Dedicated free allowance; zero blocks live calls |
| SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT | Required when applicable | Worker | Account identifier without domain suffix |
| SNOWFLAKE_USER_READER | Required when applicable | Worker | Read-only service user |
| SNOWFLAKE_USER_LOADER | Required when applicable | Publisher | Publisher service user |
| SNOWFLAKE_USER_REPORTER | Required when applicable | Analytics worker | Reporting service user |
| SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE | Required when applicable | Worker | Mounted secret file; restricted permissions |
| SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD | Required when applicable | Worker | Secret optional key passphrase |
| SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE | PARTSIQ_DEV | Worker | Allowlist PARTSIQ_DEV or PARTSIQ_PROD |
| SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE | PARTSIQ_WH | Worker | Confirmed allowance required |
| SNOWFLAKE_CREDIT_ALLOWANCE | 0 | Preflight | Zero blocks warehouse creation/resume |
| SNOWFLAKE_ALLOWANCE_EXPIRES_AT | Required when applicable | Preflight | Confirmed UTC expiry |
| SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ENABLED | false | Worker | Enable only after memory/capability check |
| BGE_MODEL_REVISION | Required when applicable | Worker | Copy verified immutable revision from infrastructure receipts |
| STOCK_MAX_AGE_SECONDS | 3600 | Domain | Provisional policy; real client chooses |
| DEMO_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS | 86400 | API | 24-hour access lifetime |
| DEMO_CLEANUP_GRACE_SECONDS | 3600 | Worker | Cleanup after access expiry plus one hour |
| JOB_LEASE_SECONDS | 120 | Worker | Heartbeat every30seconds |
| MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES | 10485760 | API and worker | 10MiB |
| MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS | 20000000 | Worker | Decoded pixel budget |
| LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY | Required when applicable | Telemetry | Optional |
| LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY | Required when applicable | Telemetry | Optional secret |
| LANGFUSE_BASE_URL | Required when applicable | Telemetry | Optional approved endpoint |
| NEXT_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN | http://localhost:8000 | Web | Public backend origin |
| NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL | Required when applicable | Web | Matching project URL |
| NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY | Required when applicable | Web | Matching public auth key |
| API_DOMAIN | Required when applicable | Caddy | Existing owner-controlled domain for hosted HTTPS |

Never place private keys in NEXT_PUBLIC variables. Preflight verifies separate dev/prod hosts and reports missing names without values. Environment seeding initializes allowance only when no existing account row exists; restarts must not reset consumed/reserved amounts. Allowance changes require admin audit.

021 docs/TECH_SPEC.md

# Technical specification

## 1 Runtime and source tree

The application is a modular monolith: one Python package, one public ASGI application and a worker importing the same domain modules. The web application is a separate Next.js build. spec/file-ownership.json is the exact planned source inventory and names each file's sole creation prompt. Later feature prompts may modify shared router, localization and shell files while retaining their original creator. Package directories require __init__.py generated by bootstrap; they contain no alternate domain implementation.

## 2 Contracts and REST

Copy spec/contracts.py and spec/api_models.py into partsiq.core. REST_API.md and spec/openapi.json define all 77operations. Foundation function signatures are listed in each prompt. Validation is layered: wire schema, authorization, domain invariants, transactional constraints. No field becomes optional merely because a UI panel is inconvenient to implement.

## 3 Exact PostgreSQL schema

The following SQL files are the authoritative schema, including tables, columns, types, constraints, indexes, roles, functions, triggers and RLS. Apply in order to a fresh disposable Supabase environment. For an existing deployed database, compare actual schema and migrate additively; never replay CREATE TABLE against live data or drop historical tables without a reviewed migration. LangGraph checkpoint migrations are not part of this edition.

### 001_initial_schema.sql

```sql
-- PartsIQ initial schema.
-- Executed automatically by the postgres container on first initialisation (empty data volume).
-- Design principle: the database is the single source of truth for part compatibility.
-- AI components may rank and describe candidates, but never decide whether a part fits a machine.

BEGIN;

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Shared trigger functions
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE FUNCTION set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Equipment catalogue
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE equipment_families (
    id          SMALLSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (code ~ '^[A-Z0-9_]{2,32}$'),
    name_en     TEXT NOT NULL,
    name_ar     TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE equipment_models (
    id            SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    family_id     SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_families (id),
    brand         TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_code    TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    rated_output  TEXT,
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (brand, model_code)
);

CREATE INDEX equipment_models_model_code_trgm_idx
    ON equipment_models USING gin (model_code gin_trgm_ops);

-- A configuration is a serial-number range of a model that shares one bill of materials.
-- Overlapping ranges for the same model are rejected so serial lookup is always unambiguous.
CREATE TABLE model_configurations (
    id            SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    model_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_models (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    config_code   TEXT NOT NULL,
    description   TEXT NOT NULL,
    serial_start  BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (serial_start >= 0),
    serial_end    BIGINT NOT NULL,
    CHECK (serial_start <= serial_end),
    UNIQUE (model_id, config_code),
    EXCLUDE USING gist (
        model_id WITH =,
        int8range(serial_start, serial_end, '[]') WITH &&
    )
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE parts (
    id               SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    part_number      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name_en          TEXT NOT NULL,
    name_ar          TEXT NOT NULL,
    description_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    category         TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_of_measure  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EA',
    is_active        BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    search_document  TSVECTOR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
        to_tsvector(
            'simple'::regconfig,
            part_number || ' ' || name_en || ' ' || name_ar || ' ' || description_en
        )
    ) STORED
);

CREATE INDEX parts_search_document_idx ON parts USING gin (search_document);
CREATE INDEX parts_part_number_trgm_idx ON parts USING gin (part_number gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX parts_category_idx ON parts (category);

CREATE TRIGGER parts_set_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON parts
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- Informal names used by customers and staff, e.g. "black filter" or Arabic colloquial terms.
CREATE TABLE part_aliases (
    id        SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    part_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    alias     TEXT NOT NULL,
    language  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (language IN ('en', 'ar')),
    UNIQUE (part_id, alias)
);

CREATE INDEX part_aliases_alias_trgm_idx ON part_aliases USING gin (alias gin_trgm_ops);

-- Embeddings are stored separately so the embedding model can be replaced without altering parts.
-- Dimension 1024 matches multilingual models such as BGE-M3, which support Arabic and English.
CREATE TABLE part_embeddings (
    part_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    model_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_text  TEXT NOT NULL,
    embedding    VECTOR(1024) NOT NULL,
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (part_id, model_name)
);

CREATE INDEX part_embeddings_hnsw_idx
    ON part_embeddings USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

-- The authoritative compatibility matrix. Every row must cite the document it was derived from.
CREATE TABLE part_compatibility (
    part_id            INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    configuration_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES model_configurations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    quantity_per_unit  NUMERIC(10, 3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity_per_unit > 0),
    source_reference   TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes              TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (part_id, configuration_id)
);

CREATE INDEX part_compatibility_configuration_idx ON part_compatibility (configuration_id);

-- Each superseded part has exactly one direct successor; chains are resolved by recursive query.
CREATE TABLE part_supersessions (
    old_part_id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    new_part_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    effective_date  DATE NOT NULL,
    reason          TEXT,
    CHECK (old_part_id <> new_part_id)
);

CREATE INDEX part_supersessions_new_part_idx ON part_supersessions (new_part_id);

CREATE FUNCTION prevent_supersession_cycle() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        WITH RECURSIVE chain (part_id) AS (
            SELECT NEW.new_part_id
            UNION
            SELECT s.new_part_id
            FROM part_supersessions AS s
            JOIN chain AS c ON s.old_part_id = c.part_id
            WHERE s.old_part_id <> NEW.old_part_id
        )
        SELECT 1 FROM chain WHERE part_id = NEW.old_part_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Supersession % -> % would create a cycle', NEW.old_part_id, NEW.new_part_id
            USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER part_supersessions_no_cycles
    BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON part_supersessions
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_supersession_cycle();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Inventory
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE warehouses (
    id      SMALLSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (code ~ '^[A-Z0-9_]{2,16}$'),
    name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    region  TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE stock_levels (
    part_id            INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    warehouse_id       SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    quantity_on_hand   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_on_hand >= 0),
    quantity_reserved  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_reserved >= 0),
    updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (part_id, warehouse_id),
    CHECK (quantity_reserved <= quantity_on_hand)
);

CREATE TRIGGER stock_levels_set_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON stock_levels
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enquiry workflow
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TYPE enquiry_status AS ENUM (
    'received',
    'processing',
    'needs_information',
    'awaiting_review',
    'approved',
    'rejected',
    'failed'
);

CREATE TABLE enquiries (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    channel             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('chat', 'email', 'staff')),
    customer_reference  TEXT,
    raw_text            TEXT NOT NULL,
    detected_language   TEXT CHECK (detected_language IN ('en', 'ar', 'mixed')),
    extracted           JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    configuration_id    INTEGER REFERENCES model_configurations (id),
    status              enquiry_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received',
    failure_reason      TEXT,
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX enquiries_status_created_idx ON enquiries (status, created_at DESC);

CREATE TRIGGER enquiries_set_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON enquiries
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

CREATE TABLE enquiry_attachments (
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    enquiry_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    storage_key  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    media_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (media_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')),
    size_bytes   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes > 0 AND size_bytes <= 10485760),
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX enquiry_attachments_enquiry_idx ON enquiry_attachments (enquiry_id);

CREATE TABLE enquiry_candidates (
    enquiry_id     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rank           SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (rank BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
    part_id        INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id),
    score          NUMERIC(6, 5) NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 1),
    match_reasons  JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    PRIMARY KEY (enquiry_id, rank),
    UNIQUE (enquiry_id, part_id)
);

CREATE TABLE review_decisions (
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    enquiry_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reviewer     TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('approved', 'edited', 'rejected')),
    final_reply  TEXT,
    comment      TEXT,
    decided_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (decision = 'rejected' OR final_reply IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX review_decisions_enquiry_idx ON review_decisions (enquiry_id, decided_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE review_approved_parts (
    decision_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES review_decisions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    part_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parts (id),
    quantity     NUMERIC(10, 3) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (decision_id, part_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Append-only audit trail
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    occurred_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    actor_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('system', 'ai', 'user')),
    actor_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    action       TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_id   TEXT,
    payload      JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

CREATE INDEX audit_log_entity_idx ON audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, occurred_at DESC);

CREATE FUNCTION prevent_audit_mutation() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'audit_log is append-only' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_update_delete
    BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON audit_log
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_audit_mutation();

CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_truncate
    BEFORE TRUNCATE ON audit_log
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_audit_mutation();

COMMIT;

```

### 002_search_and_fulfilment.sql

```sql
-- Search and fulfilment support.

BEGIN;

-- Canonical part-number key so that "vp of 1042", "VP-OF-1042" and "VPOF1042" all match.
-- Must remain consistent with partsiq_common.text.part_number_key.
ALTER TABLE parts
    ADD COLUMN part_number_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
        upper(regexp_replace(part_number, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'))
    ) STORED;

CREATE INDEX parts_part_number_key_idx ON parts (part_number_key);

-- Planned transfer lead times between warehouses, used to recommend where to fulfil from.
CREATE TABLE warehouse_transfer_routes (
    from_warehouse_id  SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_warehouse_id    SMALLINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    transfer_days      SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (transfer_days BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
    PRIMARY KEY (from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id),
    CHECK (from_warehouse_id <> to_warehouse_id)
);

COMMIT;

```

### 003_application.sql

```sql
-- Additive application schema. Apply after immutable legacy migrations 001 and 002.
BEGIN;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS app_private;
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA app_private FROM PUBLIC;
CREATE TABLE profiles (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id),
 display_name text NOT NULL CHECK(length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
 preferred_locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en' CHECK(preferred_locale IN ('en','ar')),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE staff_roles (
 user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
 role text NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('reviewer','catalogue_admin','admin')),
 granted_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 granted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(user_id,role)
);
CREATE TABLE demo_sessions (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 owner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
 generation integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(generation>0),
 expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 revoked_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK(expires_at>created_at)
);
CREATE INDEX demo_sessions_owner_idx ON demo_sessions(owner_id,expires_at DESC);
CREATE TABLE catalogue_versions (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 label text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('staging','published','retired')),
 content_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 created_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 published_at timestamptz,
 CHECK((state='staging' AND published_at IS NULL) OR (state IN ('published','retired') AND published_at IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalogue_one_published_idx ON catalogue_versions((state)) WHERE state='published';
CREATE TABLE catalogue_records (
 version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id),
 entity_type text NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('equipment_families','equipment_models','model_configurations','parts','part_aliases','part_compatibility','part_supersessions','warehouses','warehouse_transfer_routes')),
 entity_key text NOT NULL,
 payload jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(payload)='object'),
 PRIMARY KEY(version_id,entity_type,entity_key)
);
CREATE TABLE catalogue_evidence (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id),
 source_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(source_reference))>0),
 storage_key text NOT NULL,
 page_number integer NOT NULL CHECK(page_number>0),
 sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 synthetic boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 UNIQUE(version_id,source_reference)
);
ALTER TABLE part_compatibility ADD CONSTRAINT compatibility_nonempty_source CHECK(length(trim(source_reference))>0);
ALTER TABLE part_embeddings ADD COLUMN model_revision text;
ALTER TABLE part_embeddings ADD COLUMN source_sha256 text;
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN owner_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN session_id uuid REFERENCES demo_sessions(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN session_generation integer;
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN catalogue_version_id uuid REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN destination_warehouse_id smallint REFERENCES warehouses(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN assigned_to uuid REFERENCES profiles(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN priority text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK(priority IN ('normal','urgent'));
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN due_at timestamptz;
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD COLUMN idempotency_key uuid;
ALTER TABLE enquiries ADD CONSTRAINT enquiry_demo_pair CHECK((session_id IS NULL AND session_generation IS NULL) OR (session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_generation>0));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX enquiries_owner_idempotency_idx ON enquiries(owner_id,idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX enquiries_owner_created_idx ON enquiries(owner_id,created_at DESC,id);
CREATE INDEX enquiries_assigned_status_idx ON enquiries(assigned_to,status,created_at DESC,id);
CREATE INDEX enquiries_demo_idx ON enquiries(session_id,session_generation);
CREATE TABLE enquiry_items (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 ordinal smallint NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 20),
 requested_text text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(requested_text))>0),
 quantity numeric(10,3) NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0 AND quantity<=100000),
 model_text text,
 serial_text text,
 configuration_id integer REFERENCES model_configurations(id),
 selected_part_id integer REFERENCES parts(id),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unresolved' CHECK(status IN ('unresolved','needs_information','ready','unavailable')),
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 UNIQUE(enquiry_id,ordinal),
 UNIQUE(enquiry_id,id)
);

ALTER TABLE enquiry_candidates ADD COLUMN evidence_id uuid REFERENCES catalogue_evidence(id);
ALTER TABLE enquiry_candidates DROP CONSTRAINT enquiry_candidates_pkey;
ALTER TABLE enquiry_candidates DROP CONSTRAINT enquiry_candidates_enquiry_id_part_id_key;
-- Historical rows receive a legacy item before the new per-item keys are enforced.
INSERT INTO enquiry_items(enquiry_id,ordinal,requested_text,quantity,revision)
 SELECT id,1,CASE WHEN length(trim(raw_text))>0 THEN raw_text ELSE 'Historical enquiry' END,1,revision FROM enquiries;
UPDATE enquiry_candidates c SET item_id=i.id FROM enquiry_items i WHERE i.enquiry_id=c.enquiry_id AND i.ordinal=1;
ALTER TABLE enquiry_candidates ALTER COLUMN item_id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE enquiry_candidates ADD CONSTRAINT candidate_item_fk FOREIGN KEY(enquiry_id,item_id) REFERENCES enquiry_items(enquiry_id,id);

ALTER TABLE enquiry_attachments ADD COLUMN revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
CREATE TABLE messages (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('customer','clarification','status','recommendation')),
 body text NOT NULL CHECK(length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 12000),
 author_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 decision_id uuid REFERENCES review_decisions(id),
 idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(enquiry_id,idempotency_key),
 CHECK((kind='recommendation' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind<>'recommendation' AND decision_id IS NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_one_publication_idx ON messages(enquiry_id,revision) WHERE kind='recommendation';
CREATE INDEX messages_enquiry_created_idx ON messages(enquiry_id,created_at,id);
CREATE TABLE enquiry_revisions (
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 snapshot jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(snapshot)='object'),
 changed_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 reason text NOT NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(enquiry_id,revision)
);
CREATE TABLE extractions (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 attachment_id uuid REFERENCES enquiry_attachments(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL,
 model_text text,
 serial_text text,
 issues jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(jsonb_typeof(issues)='array'),
 confirmed_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 confirmed_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK((confirmed_by IS NULL)=(confirmed_at IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX extractions_enquiry_idx ON extractions(enquiry_id,revision);
CREATE TABLE fulfilment_plans (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL,
 item_id uuid NOT NULL,
 requested_quantity numeric(10,3) NOT NULL CHECK(requested_quantity>0),
 allocations jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(allocations)='array'),
 shortage numeric(10,3) NOT NULL CHECK(shortage>=0),
 stock_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(stock_snapshot)='array'),
 calculated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 FOREIGN KEY(enquiry_id,item_id) REFERENCES enquiry_items(enquiry_id,id),
 UNIQUE(item_id,revision)
);
CREATE TABLE drafts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL,
 locale text NOT NULL CHECK(locale IN ('en','ar')),
 prose jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(prose)='object'),
 verified_facts jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(verified_facts)='object'),
 rendered_text text NOT NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(enquiry_id,revision)
);
CREATE TABLE verification_results (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),

 draft_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES drafts(id),
 passed boolean NOT NULL,
 failures jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(failures)='array'),
 facts_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(facts_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(enquiry_id,revision)
);
ALTER TABLE review_decisions ADD COLUMN revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE review_decisions ADD COLUMN reviewer_id uuid REFERENCES profiles(id);
ALTER TABLE review_decisions ADD COLUMN verification_id uuid REFERENCES verification_results(id);
ALTER TABLE review_decisions ADD COLUMN idempotency_key uuid;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX review_decisions_idempotency_idx ON review_decisions(enquiry_id,idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE review_approved_parts ADD COLUMN item_id uuid REFERENCES enquiry_items(id);
CREATE TABLE internal_notes (

 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX internal_notes_enquiry_idx ON internal_notes(enquiry_id,created_at,id);
CREATE TABLE assignment_events (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),

 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE saved_machines (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), owner_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),

 label text NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
 model_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_models(id), serial_text text NOT NULL,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), archived_at timestamptz,
 CHECK((session_id IS NULL AND session_generation IS NULL) OR (session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_generation>0))
);
CREATE INDEX saved_machines_owner_idx ON saved_machines(owner_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE TABLE missing_part_requests (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 item_id uuid NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN ('open','investigating','resolved','unavailable')),
 staff_note text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', resolved_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 FOREIGN KEY(enquiry_id,item_id) REFERENCES enquiry_items(enquiry_id,id), UNIQUE(item_id)
);
CREATE TABLE jobs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer, session_generation integer,
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('nameplate','export_pdf','catalog_import','catalog_publish','storage_cleanup')),
 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled')),
 payload jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(payload)='object'),
 result jsonb, dedupe_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts>=0), max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK(max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
 available_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), lease_token uuid, lease_expires_at timestamptz,
 last_error_code text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CHECK((status='running' AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR status<>'running')
);
CREATE INDEX jobs_claim_idx ON jobs(status,available_at,lease_expires_at);
CREATE TABLE workflow_events (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id), revision integer NOT NULL,
 kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('start','message','ocr_completed','approved','retry')),
 payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', dedupe_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 processed_at timestamptz, lease_token uuid, lease_expires_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX workflow_events_pending_idx ON workflow_events(created_at) WHERE processed_at IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE exports (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 revision integer NOT NULL, decision_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES review_decisions(id),
 job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), storage_key text UNIQUE, sha256 text,
 status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','ready','failed','deleted')),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(enquiry_id,revision)
);
CREATE TABLE import_batches (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
 version_id uuid REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id), job_id uuid REFERENCES jobs(id),
 storage_key text NOT NULL, sha256 text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('uploaded','validating','invalid','valid','published')),
 row_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(row_count BETWEEN 0 AND 50000),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE import_rows (
 batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id), row_number integer NOT NULL CHECK(row_number>0),
 entity_type text NOT NULL, payload jsonb NOT NULL, errors jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 PRIMARY KEY(batch_id,row_number)
);
CREATE TABLE ai_budget_accounts (
 id text PRIMARY KEY, cap_usd numeric(14,8) NOT NULL CHECK(cap_usd>=0),
 reserved_usd numeric(14,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved_usd>=0),
 consumed_usd numeric(14,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(consumed_usd>=0),
 expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 CHECK(reserved_usd+consumed_usd<=cap_usd)
);
CREATE TABLE ai_usage (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), enquiry_id uuid REFERENCES enquiries(id),
 request_key uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, budget_account_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_budget_accounts(id),
 model text NOT NULL, stage text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('reserved','completed','uncertain','released')),
 reserved_usd numeric(14,8) NOT NULL CHECK(reserved_usd>=0), actual_usd numeric(14,8) CHECK(actual_usd>=0),
 input_tokens integer CHECK(input_tokens>=0), output_tokens integer CHECK(output_tokens>=0),
 duration_ms integer CHECK(duration_ms>=0), provider_request_id text,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ai_usage_created_idx ON ai_usage(created_at,stage);
CREATE TABLE eval_cases (
 id text PRIMARY KEY, scenario text NOT NULL, input jsonb NOT NULL, expected jsonb NOT NULL,
 catalogue_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id),
 language text NOT NULL CHECK(language IN ('en','ar','mixed')), approved_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)
);
CREATE TABLE eval_runs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), git_sha text NOT NULL, model text NOT NULL,
 dataset_sha256 text NOT NULL, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), completed_at timestamptz,
 status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('running','passed','failed'))
);
CREATE TABLE eval_results (

 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,case_id)
);
CREATE TABLE correction_records (

);
CREATE TABLE enquiry_summaries (

);

);

CREATE FUNCTION app_private.lock_supersessions() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(710069); RETURN NEW; END; $$;
CREATE TRIGGER aa_supersessions_lock BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON part_supersessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.lock_supersessions();
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.immutable_record() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable historical record' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END; $$;
CREATE TRIGGER catalogue_records_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON catalogue_records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.immutable_record();

 key uuid NOT NULL,
 request_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(request_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 response jsonb,
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(actor_id,operation,key)
);
COMMIT;
```

```sql
-- Runtime roles are NOLOGIN groups. The operator creates distinct LOGIN roles and grants one group per service.
BEGIN;
CREATE ROLE partsiq_api NOLOGIN;
CREATE ROLE partsiq_search NOLOGIN;
CREATE ROLE partsiq_workflow NOLOGIN;
CREATE ROLE partsiq_worker NOLOGIN;
CREATE ROLE partsiq_catalogue NOLOGIN;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public,app_private TO partsiq_api,partsiq_search,partsiq_workflow,partsiq_worker,partsiq_catalogue;
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.actor() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
 SELECT nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id',true),'')::uuid;
$$;
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.has_role(wanted text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_roles WHERE user_id=app_private.actor() AND role=wanted);
$$;
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.demo_active(sid uuid, gen integer, uid uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM demo_sessions WHERE id=sid AND owner_id=uid AND generation=gen AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now());
$$;
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.can_read_enquiry(eid uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enquiries e WHERE e.id=eid AND (
 (e.owner_id=app_private.actor() AND (e.session_id IS NULL OR app_private.demo_active(e.session_id,e.session_generation,e.owner_id)))
 OR (e.session_id IS NULL AND (app_private.has_role('admin') OR (e.assigned_to=app_private.actor() AND app_private.has_role('reviewer'))))));
$$;
CREATE FUNCTION app_private.can_review(eid uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enquiries e WHERE e.id=eid AND (
 (e.session_id IS NOT NULL AND e.owner_id=app_private.actor() AND app_private.demo_active(e.session_id,e.session_generation,e.owner_id))
 OR (e.session_id IS NULL AND (app_private.has_role('admin') OR (e.assigned_to=app_private.actor() AND app_private.has_role('reviewer'))))));
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA app_private FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA app_private TO partsiq_api,partsiq_search,partsiq_workflow,partsiq_worker,partsiq_catalogue;

CREATE FUNCTION app_private.validate_publication() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.kind='recommendation' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM review_decisions d JOIN enquiries e ON e.id=d.enquiry_id
 JOIN verification_results v ON v.id=d.verification_id
 WHERE d.id=NEW.decision_id AND d.enquiry_id=NEW.enquiry_id AND d.revision=NEW.revision
 AND e.revision=NEW.revision AND d.decision='approved' AND v.passed AND v.revision=NEW.revision
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval required for current revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION app_private.validate_publication() FROM PUBLIC;
CREATE TRIGGER messages_publication_guard BEFORE INSERT ON messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.validate_publication();
GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE audit_log_id_seq TO partsiq_search;
ALTER TABLE idempotency_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON idempotency_records FROM anon,authenticated;
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON idempotency_records TO partsiq_api,partsiq_workflow,partsiq_worker,partsiq_catalogue;

CREATE POLICY idempotency_internal ON idempotency_records TO partsiq_workflow,partsiq_worker,partsiq_catalogue USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
GRANT SELECT ON ai_usage TO partsiq_api;
CREATE POLICY ai_usage_metrics ON ai_usage FOR SELECT TO partsiq_api USING(app_private.has_role('admin') OR app_private.can_review(enquiry_id));
COMMIT;
```

### 005_storage.sql

```sql
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types) VALUES
 ('nameplates','nameplates',false,10485760,ARRAY['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp']),
 ('catalogue-evidence','catalogue-evidence',false,20971520,ARRAY['application/pdf']),
 ('imports','imports',false,10485760,ARRAY['text/csv','application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet']),
 ('exports','exports',false,20971520,ARRAY['application/pdf']);
CREATE FUNCTION public.partsiq_storage_allowed(object_name text, target_bucket text, write_access boolean) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public,pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); allowed boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF target_bucket='nameplates' THEN
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enquiry_attachments a JOIN enquiries e ON e.id=a.enquiry_id
 WHERE a.storage_key=object_name AND e.owner_id=actor
 AND (e.session_id IS NULL OR app_private.demo_active(e.session_id,e.session_generation,actor))
 AND ((write_access AND a.status='pending') OR (NOT write_access AND a.status='validated'))) INTO allowed;
 END IF;
 RETURN allowed;
END; $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.partsiq_storage_allowed(text,text,boolean) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.partsiq_storage_allowed(text,text,boolean) TO authenticated;
CREATE POLICY nameplate_insert ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated
 WITH CHECK(bucket_id='nameplates' AND public.partsiq_storage_allowed(name,bucket_id,true));
CREATE POLICY nameplate_read ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 USING(bucket_id='nameplates' AND public.partsiq_storage_allowed(name,bucket_id,false));
-- Other buckets have no end-user policy. Worker signs authorized downloads only after API scope validation.
COMMIT;

```

### 006_plain_workflow_and_snowflake.sql

```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE jobs DROP CONSTRAINT jobs_kind_check;
ALTER TABLE jobs ADD CONSTRAINT jobs_kind_check CHECK(kind IN ('nameplate','export_pdf','catalog_import','catalog_publish','storage_cleanup','workflow','analytics_sync','catalog_sync'));
CREATE TABLE workflow_runs (
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES enquiries(id), revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),
 step text NOT NULL CHECK(step IN ('intake','await_ocr','confirm','identify','clarify','search','choose','plan','draft','verify','review','complete','needs_staff')),
 state jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb CHECK(jsonb_typeof(state)='object'),
 lease_token uuid, lease_expires_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(enquiry_id,revision), CHECK((lease_token IS NULL)=(lease_expires_at IS NULL))
);
CREATE TABLE workflow_step_results (
 enquiry_id uuid NOT NULL, revision integer NOT NULL, step text NOT NULL,
 input_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(input_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 output jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(output)='object'), completed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(enquiry_id,revision,step,input_sha256),
 FOREIGN KEY(enquiry_id,revision) REFERENCES workflow_runs(enquiry_id,revision)
);
CREATE INDEX workflow_runs_lease_idx ON workflow_runs(lease_expires_at) WHERE lease_token IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TABLE catalogue_syncs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogue_versions(id),
 source text NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('snowflake','fixture')),
 state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('requested','remote_written','validated','activated','failed')),
 expected_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(expected_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 observed_sha256 text, record_count integer CHECK(record_count>=0), query_id text,
 error_code text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE(version_id,source)
);
CREATE TABLE analytics_outbox (
 event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), event_type text NOT NULL,
 enquiry_id uuid REFERENCES enquiries(id), revision integer,
 payload jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(payload)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), delivered_at timestamptz,
 attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts>=0), last_error_code text
);
CREATE INDEX analytics_outbox_pending_idx ON analytics_outbox(created_at,event_id) WHERE delivered_at IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE analytics_sync_runs (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), finished_at timestamptz,
 row_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(row_count>=0),
 state text NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','succeeded','failed')), query_id text, last_error_code text
);
ALTER TABLE workflow_runs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE workflow_step_results ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE catalogue_syncs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE analytics_outbox ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE analytics_sync_runs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON workflow_runs,workflow_step_results,catalogue_syncs,analytics_outbox,analytics_sync_runs FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON workflow_runs,workflow_step_results TO partsiq_api;
CREATE POLICY workflow_runs_api_read ON workflow_runs FOR SELECT TO partsiq_api USING(app_private.can_read_enquiry(enquiry_id));
CREATE POLICY workflow_results_api_read ON workflow_step_results FOR SELECT TO partsiq_api USING(app_private.can_read_enquiry(enquiry_id));
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON workflow_runs,workflow_step_results TO partsiq_workflow;
CREATE POLICY workflow_runs_job ON workflow_runs TO partsiq_workflow USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
CREATE POLICY workflow_results_job ON workflow_step_results TO partsiq_workflow USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON catalogue_syncs TO partsiq_catalogue;
CREATE POLICY catalogue_syncs_publisher ON catalogue_syncs TO partsiq_catalogue USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON analytics_outbox,analytics_sync_runs TO partsiq_worker;
CREATE POLICY analytics_outbox_worker ON analytics_outbox TO partsiq_worker USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
CREATE POLICY analytics_runs_worker ON analytics_sync_runs TO partsiq_worker USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
GRANT INSERT ON analytics_outbox TO partsiq_api,partsiq_workflow;
CREATE POLICY analytics_outbox_append ON analytics_outbox FOR INSERT TO partsiq_api,partsiq_workflow WITH CHECK(app_private.can_read_enquiry(enquiry_id));
CREATE TABLE stock_snapshot_receipts (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY, source text NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('snowflake','fixture')),
 observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL, activated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 content_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 row_count integer NOT NULL CHECK(row_count>=0), active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stock_one_active_idx ON stock_snapshot_receipts((active)) WHERE active;
ALTER TABLE stock_snapshot_receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON stock_snapshot_receipts FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT SELECT ON stock_snapshot_receipts TO partsiq_api,partsiq_search,partsiq_workflow;
CREATE POLICY stock_snapshot_read ON stock_snapshot_receipts FOR SELECT TO partsiq_api,partsiq_search,partsiq_workflow USING(true);
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON stock_snapshot_receipts TO partsiq_catalogue;
CREATE POLICY stock_snapshot_publish ON stock_snapshot_receipts TO partsiq_catalogue USING(true) WITH CHECK(true);
COMMIT;

```

## 4 Exact Snowflake schema

Snowflake standard-table PK metadata does not enforce uniqueness or foreign references. There are no PostgreSQL-style application indexes or RLS policies here. Dedicated database/schema/role grants and application validation define the boundary.

### 001_schema.sql

```sql
-- Operator executes in a dedicated development account first. No ACCOUNTADMIN in application secrets.
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.VERSIONS (
 VERSION_ID VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, CONTENT_SHA256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 RECORD_COUNT NUMBER(10,0) NOT NULL, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP_TZ NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(VERSION_ID)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.RECORDS (
 VERSION_ID VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, ENTITY_TYPE VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
 ENTITY_KEY VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, PAYLOAD VARIANT NOT NULL,
 ROW_SHA256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(VERSION_ID,ENTITY_TYPE,ENTITY_KEY)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.STOCK_SNAPSHOTS (
 SNAPSHOT_ID VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, PART_ID NUMBER(10,0) NOT NULL,
 WAREHOUSE_ID NUMBER(5,0) NOT NULL, ON_HAND NUMBER(10,3) NOT NULL,
 RESERVED NUMBER(10,3) NOT NULL, OBSERVED_AT TIMESTAMP_TZ NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(SNAPSHOT_ID,PART_ID,WAREHOUSE_ID)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING.EVENTS (
 EVENT_ID VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, EVENT_TYPE VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
 OCCURRED_AT TIMESTAMP_TZ NOT NULL, IS_DEMO BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
 STATUS VARCHAR(40), STAGE VARCHAR(40), DURATION_MS NUMBER(12,3),
 INPUT_TOKENS NUMBER(12,0), OUTPUT_TOKENS NUMBER(12,0), ESTIMATED_COST_USD NUMBER(18,8),
 PRIMARY KEY(EVENT_ID)
);
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING.DAILY_METRICS AS
 SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY',OCCURRED_AT) AS DAY, IS_DEMO, EVENT_TYPE,
 COUNT(*) AS EVENT_COUNT, AVG(DURATION_MS) AS MEAN_DURATION_MS,
 SUM(ESTIMATED_COST_USD) AS ESTIMATED_COST_USD
 FROM PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING.EVENTS GROUP BY 1,2,3;
-- PK declarations are metadata. Publication and outbox writers validate uniqueness themselves.

```

### 002_roles.sql

```sql
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_READER;
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_LOADER;
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS PARTSIQ_REPORTER;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE PARTSIQ_DEV TO ROLE PARTSIQ_READER;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE TO ROLE PARTSIQ_READER;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE TO ROLE PARTSIQ_READER;
GRANT ROLE PARTSIQ_READER TO ROLE PARTSIQ_LOADER;
GRANT INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE TO ROLE PARTSIQ_LOADER;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE PARTSIQ_DEV TO ROLE PARTSIQ_REPORTER;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING TO ROLE PARTSIQ_REPORTER;
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON TABLE PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING.EVENTS TO ROLE PARTSIQ_REPORTER;
GRANT SELECT ON VIEW PARTSIQ_DEV.REPORTING.DAILY_METRICS TO ROLE PARTSIQ_REPORTER;
-- Grant warehouse USAGE to these roles only after the confirmed credit preflight.
-- Create service users and register their public RSA keys through the operator setup prompt.

```

### 003_validation_queries.sql

```sql
SELECT VERSION_ID,ENTITY_TYPE,ENTITY_KEY,COUNT(*) AS N
 FROM PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.RECORDS GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)<>1;
SELECT VERSION_ID,COUNT(*) AS N FROM PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.VERSIONS GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)<>1;
SELECT SNAPSHOT_ID,PART_ID,WAREHOUSE_ID,COUNT(*) AS N
 FROM PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.STOCK_SNAPSHOTS GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)<>1;
SELECT * FROM PARTSIQ_DEV.CATALOGUE.STOCK_SNAPSHOTS
 WHERE ON_HAND<0 OR RESERVED<0 OR RESERVED>ON_HAND OR OBSERVED_AT>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();
-- Relationship, serial-range, supersession-cycle and evidence checks run on the typed snapshot before activation.

```

## 5 Dependency and environment contracts

DEPENDENCIES.md lists every direct version, release date and installation prompt. spec/python-requirements.lock and spec/pnpm-lock.yaml capture resolved references. ENVIRONMENT.md lists every runtime variable, default, consumer and secret status. No credential values are embedded in this kit.
